verdict.rationale: Loops documents a `POST /events/send` endpoint to trigger workflows [loops-docs-3], and states that sending events starts published workflows [loops-docs-27]. Workflows are built around your product events [loops-docs-30], and events can also be sent from the CLI [loops-docs-23]. This clearly covers the core of firing a custom event to start an automation. missing for 10: explicit documentation that the event is tied to a specific contact (e.g. email/userId in the payload) so only that person enters the workflow, details on custom event names/properties, independent hands-on corroboration.
